__note__: English translations for Steam Workshop Mod Assistant V2. Chinese text → English. Keys starting with __ are section comments, ignored by t().
把全部档案与全部 mod 记录（含快照、备份登记、操作日志、判决史等 8 张表）: Export all profiles and mod records (8 tables) as a single JSON for migration / full backup
从导出的 JSON 文件恢复账本。注意：导入会整体替换当前账本（清库重灌），操作: Restore ledger from exported JSON. Note: this replaces the entire current ledger; you will be asked to confirm
把当前游戏的收录清单（含备注、标签、特别关注等整理成果）导出为 JSON 发给别: Export the current game's collection as JSON to share; excludes local-only info like download status
把别人发来的分享包并入当前账本：已有的 mod 自动跳过，绝不改动现有数据: Merge a shared pack into the current ledger; existing mods auto-skipped, never modifies existing data
在文件管理器打开当前档案的 mod 下载目录（steamcmd 工坊内容目录，里: Open current profile's mod download folder in File Explorer. Select a game profile first
在文件管理器打开本软件的文件夹——绿色软件，账本（mods.db）等数据都在其中: Open this app's folder in File Explorer — portable; ledger (mods.db) and data are in the data subdirectory
输入 AppID 一屏建档：自动查名、查重、下载目录按 steamcmd 位置推: Create profile by AppID: auto-lookup name, check duplicates, preview download folder
编辑当前游戏档案（如显示名称）——保存成功后下拉框与各页同步更新: Edit current profile (e.g. display name) — dropdown and all pages update on save
备份文件夹被搬动/改名后，把当前档案的备份目录指针指回文件真正所在的位置——先预: After backup folder moved/renamed, point profile's backup directory back to actual location — preview first, write on confirm
删除当前游戏档案：先盘点名下账目，确认后自动做数据库快照兜底、一个事务清账；磁盘: Delete current profile: tally records first, auto-create DB snapshot as safety, clear in one transaction; disk backup handled per checkbox (kept by default)
打开 mod 库高级筛选：标题/备注/编号/作者/大小/更新时间/标签多条件叠加: Open advanced mod filter: title/notes/ID/author/size/update/tags. Works with top-bar filter.\nNon-modal — keep open while browsing; shortcut Ctrl+Shift+F
底部控制台面板（运行日志 + steamcmd 终端两个标签页）的显隐开关；隐藏: Toggle bottom console panel (run log + steamcmd terminal); auto-shows per settings on new log entries
若控制台被拖成了独立浮动窗口，点这里停回主窗口底部；也可以直接双击浮动窗标题栏切: If console is floating, click to dock it back; or double-click the floating window title bar
mod 库页右侧的详情面板（选中条目的字段、确认来源与最近判决）显隐开关: Toggle detail panel on mod library page (fields, source confirmation, recent verdicts)
当前游戏：（无）—— 请先添加档案: Current game: (none) — Add a profile first
本工具（V2）已有另一个窗口在运行（可能最小化在任务栏）。\\n\\n请切换到那: Another instance (V2) is already running.\n\nPlease switch to that window — running two would interfere
帮助大量使用 mod 的 Steam 玩家，在不打开 Steam 客户端的情况下: Helps Steam players manage workshop mods — register, check updates, download, backup/restore — without opening the Steam client. Portable: all data is stored in the app's own folder.
先读我：怎么采 · 怎么中断 · 出口两条: Read First: How to Collect · Stop · Export
先读我：怎么取 · 出口两条: Read First: How to Fetch · Export
实时采集中：会占用鼠标键盘，请勿操作；中断 = Esc 轻点一下 / 随便动一下: Collecting: mouse/keyboard occupied. Stop = tap Esc / move mouse / Alt+Tab here & click Stop
双击浮动窗标题栏也能切回停靠；拖标题栏可以把面板从主窗口拖出来独立使用: Double-click floating title bar to toggle docking; drag title bar to detach
实时采集 Edge 当前打开的标签页：点下方按钮后，程序自己逐个切换标签读取网址: Live-collect currently open Edge tabs. The program switches tabs one-by-one to read URLs (occupies mouse/keyboard during collection; tap Esc or move mouse to stop). Keep only non-duplicate tabs you want to download (blank pages are auto-skipped). Workshop items are pre-checked — use [Send to Add Mod] to register, or [Copy Selected URLs] to paste into [Account Center · Register].
读取 Firefox 当前打开的标签页：点下方按钮后，程序直读 Firefox: Read currently open Firefox tabs. The program reads Firefox's session backup directly — no mouse/keyboard lock, no need to touch Firefox. Workshop items are pre-checked — use [Send to Add Mod] to register, or [Copy Selected URLs] to paste into [Account Center · Register].
还没采集。点【实时采集 Edge 标签页…】开始：程序会自动切换 Edge 的标: Not yet collected. Click [Live-Collect Edge Tabs…] to start. The program switches through Edge tabs automatically; results appear here when done (workshop items pre-checked).
还没读取。点【读取 Firefox 标签页…】开始：程序直读 Firefox 会: Not yet read. Click [Read Firefox Tabs…] to start. The program reads Firefox's session backup directly; results appear here (workshop items pre-checked).
